name: KCD Cairo 2027
tagline: The cloud native community is coming to Cairo.
description: Kubernetes Community Days Cairo 2027 is a community-organized, CNCF-supported event bringing together adopters, contributors and technologists from the open source and cloud native ecosystem in Egypt and the region. Dates, venue, call for proposals, sponsorship and registration will be announced here.

newsletter.title: Get KCD Cairo updates
newsletter.text: Be the first to hear when the date is locked in, the call for proposals opens and tickets go on sale. No spam, unsubscribe any time.
